source: OpenStreetMap ways: footway, steps, pedestrian, path, corridor; streets: service, living_street, residential, unclassified, tertiary, secondary, primary, tertiary_link, secondary_link, primary_link, pedestrian
note: Community data. Edges are OSM way stretches between junctions; 'levels' is the OSM level tag (two values on stairs/escalators/ramps = connects those levels; null = street level). Lift nodes carry their levels. kind 'street' = road centreline (street_class), walkable along a pavement that OSM does not map separately; crossing a road is only modelled where OSM has a footway crossing it. Node ids are OSM node ids, or 'c<lon>,<lat>' where the road extract carries no ids.
